raw.details:
About Orbix:

Orbix is a global, open-innovation hackathon organized by Makers Need More (MnM), bringing together developers, students, designers, and innovators to identify and solve real-world problems through technology.

  • Event Format: Global, online hackathon
  • Duration: Approximately 48 hours of building and submissions, followed by finalist presentations
  • Organizer: Makers Need More (MnM)
  • Event Dates: 21–23 November 2026
  • Join WhatsApp Group here.

Problem Statements and Project Scope:

Orbix follows an open-innovation format. Participants are encouraged to identify a genuine problem, research its impact, and develop an original technology-driven solution.

Communication and Support:

Participants should follow the official Orbix event page and Makers Need More (MnM) communication channels for announcements, qualification updates, submission instructions, and finalist presentation details.

Registered participants will be invited to join the designated MnM WhatsApp community for relevant event updates and coordination.
